prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: one high-fidelity portrait mobile-first web app UI screen
Primary request: Design a production-ready LatteArt interactive latte art simulator screen in a mature, restful lacquer service-tray visual world. It must read immediately as real operable product UI, not a poster, photograph, mood board, or device mockup.
Scene/backdrop: the entire edge-to-edge 390 x 844-style smartphone viewport is a deep handmade lacquer surface, near-black oxblood #2B1718 with restrained wine #6F2430 tonal depth and subtle authentic lacquer texture. No phone frame and no outer background.
Subject and structure: compact top bar with the brand at left, a small language control and a closed settings button at right. The center is dominated by one very large round white matte-porcelain latte canvas, with a slim dimensional ceramic rim, warm coffee and cream fluid pattern inside, soft physically plausible shadow onto the lacquer tray, and a subtle active touch ripple/pour trace that clearly signals direct manipulation. Beneath the cup, in easy thumb reach, place one coherent tactile tool tray with exactly three immediately available controls: Pour, Stir, Lift. Use precise original line icons: a small pouring pitcher, a stirring wand, and a lifting/pipette gesture; no emoji. Make Pour visibly selected with a decisive filled wine-red state, while Stir and Lift remain high-contrast ivory controls. Put a compact Reset action below or beside the tool tray. Show advanced settings only as collapsed: the top settings button is closed, and no sliders or parameter fields are exposed.
Style/medium: high-fidelity shippable mobile product UI screenshot, crisp typography, disciplined spacing, strong accessible contrast, restrained dimensionality, elegant service ritual rather than luxury advertising. Mature and calm, with slight playfulness only in the responsive latte fluid.
Composition/framing: portrait, approximately 390:844 aspect ratio, edge-to-edge app viewport. Clear scale hierarchy: compact header, enormous central circular canvas, compact bottom tool tray. Generous breathing room without making controls feel distant. Touch targets look at least 44px tall. No device chrome.
Color palette: #2B1718, #6F2430, #F2E9D8, #C78455, #FBFAF4 only, plus natural coffee brown derived from the scene.
Materials/textures: deep hand-lacquered tray, matte porcelain, finely brushed copper accents used sparingly.
Text (verbatim): render only these exact strings, each once where appropriate: "LatteArt", "Pour", "Stir", "Lift", "Reset", "繁中 / EN".
Typography: fully legible refined humanist sans-serif interface type with a subtle editorial character for the LatteArt wordmark; correct letterforms; no tiny decorative copy.
Constraints: unmistakably interactive simulator; large round latte canvas central; Pour, Stir, Lift all immediately available in thumb reach; compact top brand, language, settings; advanced settings collapsed; selected state must not rely on subtle color difference alone; no invented claims; no extra labels; no hidden main tools; no watermark.
Avoid: poster design, product photography, hands, people, café scene, device frame, browser chrome, gradients as decoration, glassmorphism, generic card grid, childish colors, cute illustration, excessive gold, neon, emoji, Unicode glyph icons, illegible text, gibberish, extra copy, logos other than the LatteArt wordmark, watermark.
